```{r}
w <- c("EVELYN", "LAURA", "THERESA", "BRENDA", "CHARLOTTE", "FRANCES", "ELEANOR", "PEARL", "RUTH", "VERNE", "MYRNA", "KATHERINE", "SYLVIA", "NORA", "HELEN", "DOROTHY", "OLIVIA", "FLORA")

    affil.el <- data.frame(matrix(ncol = 2, nrow = 0))
    k <- 1
    for (i in 1:nrow(A)) {
        for(j in 1:ncol(A)) {
            if (A[i, j] == 1) {
              affil.el[k, 1] = w[i]
              affil.el[k, 2] = e[j]
            k <- k + 1
            }
```

```{r bipart, fig.width=20, fig.height=8, fig.fullwidth=TRUE, caption = "Southern women bipartite graph."}
    gr <- graph_from_data_frame(data.frame(affil.el), directed = FALSE)
    V(gr)$type <- bipartite_mapping(gr)$type
    p <- ggraph(gr, layout = 'bipartite') 
    p <- p + geom_edge_link(color = "steelblue", edge_width = 1.05) 
    p <- p + geom_node_point(color = c(rep("white", 18), rep("tan2", 14)), 
                             shape = c(rep("square", 18), rep("circle", 14)), 
                             size = c(rep(15, 18), rep(20, 14)))
    p <- p + geom_node_text(aes(label = name), 
                            size = c(rep(4.5, 18), rep(5, 14)), 
                            color = "black")   
    p <- p + theme_graph() + theme(legend.position = "none") 
    p
```

The Figure above shows the **bipartite graph** corresponding to the *Southern Women Events Data* a classic social network data set collected in the 1930s by the sociologist Allison Davis and collaborators and included in book [*Deep South*](https://www.amazon.com/Deep-South-Anthropological-Southern-Classics/dp/1570038155). The graph represents observed attendance at 14 social events by 18 Southern "high society" women from the South. 

(@) Write down the **affiliation matrix** corresponding to the Southern women network bipartite graph (2pts).

```{r}
    a <- matrix(" ", nrow = 18, ncol = 14)
    rownames(a) <- w
    colnames(a) <- e
    kbl(a, format = "html", padding = 1, align = "c") %>% 
        kable_classic(lightable_options = "striped") %>% 
        kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive")) %>% 
        row_spec(1:18, color = "black", extra_css = "border-bottom: 1px solid;") %>% 
        column_spec(1:14, color = "black", border_right = TRUE, border_left = TRUE)
```

